newsitem.title: UK: SSY predicts rates to fall in several tanker sectors.
newsitem.headline: SSY predicts rates to fall in several tanker sectors.

text.p: Tanker rates are likely to fall across many sectors, SSY Consultancy and Research said in its latest monthly report.
SSY said: "The Easter holiday period could take the steam out of the market, thus be prepared for rates to fall in many areas."
It said a steady fall in crude oil prices during March had spurred activity, especially in the North Sea and West Africa.
SSY added that a domino-effect in the Atlantic had pushed rates up.

But the UK ship broker said estimates from the IEA indicated that 0.5 million barrels a day and 1.0 mb/d primary distillation capacity are to be shut down for post-winter maintenance in April and May.
"Thus a notable reduction of crude shipments to Japan in the second quarter is expected to occur,' SSY said.
